baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messenger-clause appears first inside the hypocrites' نَشْهَدُ and then under God's يَعْلَمُ, before the speakers themselves are called liars.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah separates proposition, warrant, and speaker. Their qawl emits a true clause, but shahada is knowledge-bearing disclosure; divine knowledge warrants the clause while divine counter-testimony evaluates the claimants. كَاذِبُونَ therefore falls on their enacted claim to be witnesses, not on the messengerhood nested inside their words.

activation_trace.role: Uttered qawl supplies the audible proposition whose truth can be separated from the speaker's posture.
Knowledge-based declaration distinguishes a warranted witness from merely pronouncing witness-language.
Disclosure to the knower grounds the repeated messenger-clause independently of the first speakers.
Falsehood is assigned to the speakers while the content they voiced has just been ratified.

changed_reading.before: They are liars because the sentence they utter is false.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is expressly true; the lie is their presentation of tongue-speech as a knowledge-grounded act of witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ٱلْمُنَافِقُونَ bracket the whole spoken exchange, while قَالُوا exposes one route and leaves their inner position unstated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hypocrisy root supplies a traversable passage and, more sharply, a displayed door with a concealed outlet. The true public clause becomes an entrance into affiliation while an unvoiced contrary commitment remains the escape route. The ayah's repeated hypocrite-label encloses the testimony inside that two-route architecture.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating tunnel with an outlet gives the speaker's affiliation a two-route spatial mechanism.
The shown entrance and hidden exit map directly onto public testimony and concealed withdrawal.
Unexpressed inner speech supplies the live but withheld side of the public utterance.

changed_reading.before: Hypocrisy is a generic mismatch between speech and belief.
changed_reading.after: Hypocrisy is engineered access: a true sentence opens the visible communal door while the speaker preserves a concealed route out.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَاءَكَ ... قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ ... رَسُولُ organizes arrival around delivery of a statement about the authorized bearer of a message.
baseline_models.mechanism: Activating the causative edge of coming, their arrival can be heard as bringing something: a verbal credential. The tongue acts as witness and carries a message about the true message-carrier. This is form-distant because جَاءَكَ is intransitive, but the tightly sequenced arrival and declaration keep the delivery model anchored.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and presenting something turns arrival into a staged delivery of testimony.
The witnessing tongue is the instrument that presents the credential.
Message and message-bearer make their statement a carried claim about the genuinely authorized carrier.

changed_reading.before: They happen to visit and then state a belief.
changed_reading.after: They stage an arrival whose cargo is a verbal credential designed to establish their standing before the Messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah makes pledged speech into acquired protective equipment and then into a means of redirecting others. This sharpens the opening testimony from mere concealment into an active shield: witness-language protects the hidden exit and enables obstruction of the path.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as visible witness locates the defensive surface in speech itself.
The oath branch supplies a formalized verbal pledge parallel to the opening declaration.
A protective shield turns pledged speech into cover rather than disclosure.
Turning and diverting gives the verbal cover an outward social effect.
The extended traversable path is what defensive speech succeeds in obstructing.

structural_cues: 63:2 orders taking oaths, making them a shield, and then diverting from the path, so verbal cover precedes operational harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, shield, diversion, and path; I infer that the focus testimony functions like the adjacent defensive pledge. A live alternative is that 63:2 gives a separate example of protective speech rather than explaining this exact declaration.

changed_reading.before: Their testimony hides an inward contradiction.
changed_reading.after: Their testimony is defensive infrastructure: it covers the hidden outlet and grants room to redirect the community.

context_deltas.mechanism: A correct formula can remain on the speaking surface like a repeatable impression while the heart beneath it is sealed and does not understand. The lie is no longer only a privately known contradiction; it can also be a severance between fluent reproduction and inward apprehension.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the reproducible outer formula.
Stamping and imaging provide the model of a fixed surface impression.
The heart names the interior from which the polished declaration is disconnected.
Absent understanding prevents correct wording from becoming inwardly possessed witness.

structural_cues: 63:3 moves from belief to covering, then to a stamped heart and lack of understanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stamping, heart, and failed understanding; I supply the arrow from a fixed interior to formulaic surface reproduction. Alternatively, the stamp may only block later reception and need not generate their speech.

changed_reading.before: They knowingly substitute a false inward belief with a true sentence.
changed_reading.after: Their mouths may reproduce the right imprint while the sealed center cannot apprehend or own what the imprint says.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their speech can attract listening even while their persons are likened to rigid timber that stands only by support. Read back into the focus, the true messenger-clause stands because God independently supports it, not because these speakers possess the integrity to bear its weight.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing tongue isolates an effective verbal surface from the person behind it.
Emitted speech is the attractive surface whose force needs explanation.
Actual auditory capture shows that counterfeit witness can still be rhetorically effective.
Rigid propped timber supplies a material model for a person unable to carry the statement from within.
Dependence and leaning make the clause's stability borrowed rather than speaker-generated.

structural_cues: 63:4 places compelling speech immediately before the image of propped timber.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies audible attraction and externally supported timber; I map the support onto the true clause's independent divine ratification. The image may instead describe their persons generally, without specifying why their words remain true.

changed_reading.before: A true statement from a liar is simply an isolated semantic accident.
changed_reading.after: The statement is borrowed truth: audible and upright only because an authority outside these speakers supports it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their immediate declaration on arrival can be heard as speech offered before any question. The later conviction that every alarming cry is directed against them supplies a motive: they preempt imagined accusation by arriving with a maximal declaration of loyalty already prepared.

activation_trace.role: Their arrival supplies the scene in which the unsolicited declaration is launched.
Immediate voiced speech becomes a possible anticipatory response.
Suspicious reckoning supplies the expectation that accusation is always imminent.
The alarming cry provides the imagined charge that their testimony tries to outrun.

structural_cues: 63:1 reports their declaration immediately upon arrival without recording a question; 63:4 reports that they take every cry as being against them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsolicited timing and generalized alarm; I infer a fear-to-speech arrow. Their opening testimony could instead be a routine delegation formula unrelated to the later fear response.

changed_reading.before: They volunteer a conventional but insincere greeting.
changed_reading.after: They speak first to occupy the witness position before the accusation they continually expect can occupy it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening arrival is exposed as controlled proximity rather than readiness to submit. When they are called to approach for the Messenger's restorative intercession, head-twisting, turning away, and self-magnification replace approach. They come while they control the credential, but refuse the coming that would confess need.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary coming supplies the apparently cooperative approach that context reclassifies.
The summons to come up creates a second, morally exposing approach scene.
Protective covering of fault identifies what accepting the second approach would seek.
Turning away materializes the concealed withdrawal already latent in their speech.
Refusal and diversion reverse the direction of their earlier approach.
Self-magnification explains why they accept credentialed presence but reject confessed dependence.

structural_cues: The same Messenger they affirm in 63:1 becomes the mediator they physically refuse to approach in 63:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two approach scenes and the second scene's refusal; I infer that control of self-presentation distinguishes them. A live alternative is that 63:1's coming and 63:5's summons concern different occasions without deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Coming to the Messenger is evidence of at least outward submission.
changed_reading.after: Their approach is selective: they enter to author their standing and turn away when approach would place them in need of the Messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testimony now reads as an insider credential with operational value. Those who verbally recognize the Messenger remain close enough to issue a no-spending policy aimed at breaking apart the people around him. Their true title for him secures proximity while their later qawl works against the social body organized by that title.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-title is the credential's true content and the community's organizing center.
Later uttered speech reveals that their words are used to coordinate policy, not only report belief.
The spending branch identifies the resource flow they order others to stop.
Nearness and presence define the human circle targeted by the resource blockade.
The Messenger reappears as the spatial center whose surrounding network they seek to thin.
Dispersal of an assembled group states the intended social result of withholding.

structural_cues: 63:7 runs from their qawl through stopped spending to dispersal of those around the Messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same group, the Messenger-title, proximity, resource restriction, and intended dispersal; I infer that opening testimony helps preserve insider access from which this policy can be voiced. The text does not explicitly state that the 63:1 delegation itself issued the order.

changed_reading.before: The testimony is private camouflage for unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The testimony is also a credential for remaining near the center while using insider speech to starve and disperse its surrounding community.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their later qawl supplies the practical rank-map hidden beneath the opening title. They verbally call him God's Messenger but imagine social force as belonging to the party that can expel a humiliated other; the correction assigns might to God, the Messenger, and believers and again marks the hypocrites as not knowing. Their politics supplies the contrary predicate their first sentence concealed.

activation_trace.role: The true office-title carries an implied relation of authorized standing.
Their second explicit utterance exposes the operative hierarchy beneath their first.
Forcing someone outside turns their rank-claim into a concrete political program.
Dominance and overcoming expose where they actually locate effective authority.
Subjection under force is the status they assign to the party opposed to their imagined strong one.
The Messenger is explicitly restored inside the corrected ownership of might.
Their lack of disclosed knowledge echoes why their opening shahada lacked warrant.

structural_cues: 63:8 places their expulsion hierarchy directly before a correction that gives might to God, His Messenger, and believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies their title, their later hierarchy, and its correction; I infer that sincere recognition of the office entails a practical rank-relation. One could assent to the office while sinfully contesting its social implications, but that severance is precisely the changed form of the lie.

changed_reading.before: They affirm the Messenger's office while privately disbelieving it.
changed_reading.after: They pronounce the right office but assign effective might in the opposite direction; their operational rank-map falsifies their verbal recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names the focus figures as managers of a shown door and hidden exit later joins the prohibited expenditure to their name in 63:7, then opens 63:10 as a command to spend. The requested final act is charity, where the truth-root becomes an actual transfer of wealth and right. The sequence counter-programs concealed exit with transparent outflow and spoken truth with enacted truth.

activation_trace.role: A displayed entrance with hidden exit defines the focus figures' concealed management of passage.
The spending image makes prohibited material outflow and the hypocrite-label collide within one root occurrence.
The group's dispersal is the social depletion sought by blocking material outflow.
Commanded expenditure reverses the blocked flow into an open, accountable exit of wealth.
Charity as wealth and due right embodies truth in transfer rather than leaving it at the tongue.

structural_cues: 63:7 places the spending verb and hypocrite noun under one ن ف ق occurrence; 63:10 begins with the opposed command to spend and culminates in charity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, blocked flow, commanded flow, and charity; I infer a semantic counter-program from concealed exit to transparent expenditure. The shared root can be treated as lexical convergence rather than deliberate causal explanation, but the ordered resource sequence keeps the activation live.

changed_reading.before: The hypocrite's defect is repaired by replacing a false profession with a sincere profession.
changed_reading.after: The concealed-exit person is countered by open outflow: truth becomes visible when possessed resources leave transparently as an acknowledged right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening and close share the frame إِذَا جَاءَ. At first, people arrive before the Messenger with scripted cargo; at the close, each self's fixed term arrives and cannot be delayed, while God knows the interior of what is done. Grammatical control reverses: the managed visitor becomes the one visited by an arrival no credential can manage.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining establish the opening arrival that the speakers appear to control.
The same coming image returns with the fixed term as agent, reversing who controls the encounter.
A fixed temporal limit makes the closing arrival non-negotiable.
The very self, rather than its public credential, becomes the object reached by the deadline.
Knowledge of report and inner reality closes the gap that their opening performance exploited.

structural_cues: 63:1 opens with إِذَا جَاءَكَ and 63:11 closes with إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا, followed by God's awareness of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact arrival repetition, changed grammatical agent, fixed term, and inner knowledge; I infer a reversal from staged approach to unavoidable visitation. The repeated formula may function as closure without specifically reclassifying the opening delegation.

changed_reading.before: Their arrival is a self-contained scene of deceptive diplomacy.
changed_reading.after: Their managed arrival is the first half of a reversal: eventually an unmanageable arrival reaches the self, where performed testimony yields to known action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The colored-cloth branch is materially remote from ordinary كذب and must be rendered as an analogy, not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in كَاذِبُونَ and the displayed-door structure: an artifact can contain real material while its presented state misrepresents what it is, just as their true clause misrepresents its wearers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَاذِبُونَ judges speakers whose displayed testimony is true in wording but false as a presentation of their state.

activation_trace.role: A patterned or dyed garment that lies by its condition models truthful verbal material fashioned into a false public appearance.
The shown door and hidden outlet supply the wearer-state concealed by the verbal garment.

changed_reading.before: A lie is only a proposition that fails to match facts.
changed_reading.after: Their speech lies like a garment can lie by state: its true verbal fabric is arranged to display a false identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The honey-in-wax image is a root-level material activation, not the lexical sense of نَشْهَدُ. It remains worth carrying because the ayah itself preserves sweet or valid content inside a rejected witness-act, and 63:2 immediately supplies protective casing; downstream prose should mark the image as exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The messenger-clause remains valid inside a testimony whose speakers are rejected.

activation_trace.role: Honey still enclosed in wax models true content retained inside a compromised performative casing.
Protective casing strengthens the image of a valuable interior enclosed by defensive speech.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting the witnesses requires discarding everything inside their testimony.
changed_reading.after: The ayah breaks the casing without losing the content: messengerhood remains the honey extracted from a defensive and counterfeit witness-act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The attribution branch of س ن د is branch-distant from the surface image of propped timber, so it should not erase that primary image. It is nevertheless anchored by the focus problem of a true qawl attributed to false witnesses; render it as a secondary technical analogy about attribution, not as a historical claim about hadith terminology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus distinguishes the truth of what is said from whether these speakers can truthfully stand behind 'we witness.'

activation_trace.role: The emitted statement supplies content that can be assessed apart from its attribution.
Assigning falsity to a person focuses the failure on the claimant rather than the ratified clause.
Raising a statement to its speaker activates attribution as the exact joint that fails.

changed_reading.before: The opening dispute concerns only whether the sentence is true.
changed_reading.after: Its content stands, but its attribution as these speakers' witness does not: the failed joint is between statement and claimant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: 63:9 addresses believers, so this should not be flattened into an identification of every distracted believer with the focus hypocrites. It remains anchored to the witnessing tongue and reveals a coexisting mechanism: correct God-language can continue while wealth and offspring govern attention. Render it as a generalized hazard illuminated by the focus, not a categorical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tongue says a correct God-centered sentence while the ayah questions whether that sentence represents the speaker's governing center.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing tongue supplies correct outward God-language.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies attentional rather than merely propositional displacement.
Accumulated wealth names one rival center capable of directing conduct beneath correct speech.
Remembrance running on the tongue makes explicit that verbal mention need not equal undiverted orientation.

changed_reading.before: Counterfeit witness requires a consciously held contrary proposition.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting mechanism is divided governance: correct remembrance remains on the tongue while another object occupies the decision-making center.

strongest_changes: The messenger-clause is true, so كَاذِبُونَ judges the claim to knowledge-bearing witness rather than the embedded proposition.
63:2 turns formal speech into a shield that protects a hidden exit and enables active obstruction.
The repeated ن ف ق root counterposes concealed passage and blocked spending with transparent expenditure and charity as enacted truth.
The later expulsion hierarchy reveals an operative rank-map that contradicts the true Messenger-title on their tongues.
The repeated إِذَا جَاءَ frame reverses a managed arrival before the Messenger into the fixed term's unmanageable arrival at the self.
summary.what_was_special: The focus does not ask the reader to choose between true and false speech. It preserves a true proposition while exposing several ways its speakers can falsify the act that carries it: defensive cover, inaccessible interior, borrowed support, anticipatory fear, selective proximity, resource warfare, and contrary rank-allocation.
remaining_uncertainties: The 'brought credential' baseline activates a causative branch against an intransitive surface and should remain exploratory.
The propped-speech, cloth, honey, and attribution models are material or branch-distant analogies, not replacement lexical glosses.
The נ ف ق outflow counter-program is strongly sequenced but may be lexical convergence rather than an intended causal explanation.
The 63:9 attentional model crosses an address shift to believers and therefore generalizes a hazard without equating identities.
